title: Darker Nights - Remastered
summary: Standalone night lighting, night grading, camera-light and moon-size controls for DX12.
notes: Works with SDR or native HDR, rasterized lighting, ray tracing and path tracing.
Can run alongside an HDR addon without lighting overrides. Remove Artificial Player Lights and avoid duplicate night-lighting hooks.
Native hooks validate both the previous remastered renderer layout and the October 8 updated layout.
